Available tools:
- get_profile_posts: Reliable API for all LinkedIn Scraping Needs: profiles, companies, activities/posts, and job posts. This API scrapes data directly from LinkedIn upon request so that you'll get real-time data. Say goo
- extract_contacts: Email and phone extractor allows you to scrape any website for contact information. That's right - any website.
- google_drive_create_file_from_metadata: Read, write, and sync files stored in Google Drive from your mobile and web apps.. Creates a new file from metadata.For metadata-only requests.

I'm vetting a potential partner and have their details: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/alex-mercer-global and personal site https://alexmercer.io. Can you compile a report with any contact info found and save it to my Drive?

The tool successfully retrieved Alex Mercer's LinkedIn profile details and recent posts. This confirms professional activity but lacks the direct contact information required for your report. I will now scan the provided personal website to locate email or phone details before saving the compiled file.

The website scan successfully retrieved two email addresses and one phone number from the provided URL. This completes the data collection required for your partner vetting report. I will now compile these details with the LinkedIn findings and save the document to your Drive.
